Dinner experience after work in Nha Trang
Aug 2026 • Business
After a day of meeting clients in Nha Trang, I want to find a proper place to eat instead of stopping at a roadside stall. Johnny Steak House is quite easy to find, and upon entering, the arrangement of tables and chairs is neat, with moderate lighting so it doesn't feel too fancy. I choose a piece of steak with mushroom sauce. The meat was served on a hot pan, the outside was perfectly grilled, and the inside was exactly the doneness I requested. The fungal fever is not too severe, so I can eat the whole portion without feeling full. The price is mid-range, suitable for a post-work dinner. Payment was a little slow because it was peak time and there were quite a few customers.
